mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) )
SELECT member_id, email, last_name, first_name, password_hash FROM members WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND member_status = 'active'
SELECT member_id, email, last_name, first_name FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_status = 'active'

SELECT personal_or_corporate, last_name, first_name, last_name_kana, first_name_kana, company_name, department_name, email, gender, anniversary_date, newsletter_opt_in, postal_code, prefecture, city, address_line, delivery_floor, has_elevator, daytime_phone, fax FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_status = 'active'

INSERT INTO members ( personal_or_corporate, last_name, first_name, last_name_kana, first_name_kana, company_name, department_name, email, gender, anniversary_date, password_hash, newsletter_opt_in, postal_code, prefecture, city, address_line, delivery_floor, has_elevator, daytime_phone, fax, member_status, withdrawn_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{form.personalOrCorporate}, #{form.lastName}, #{form.firstName}, #{form.lastNameKana}, #{form.firstNameKana}, #{form.companyName}, #{form.departmentName}, #{form.email}, #{form.gender}, #{form.anniversaryDate}, #{passwordHash}, #{form.newsletterOptIn}, #{form.postalCode}, #{form.prefecture}, #{form.city}, #{form.addressLine}, CAST(#{form.deliveryFloor} AS INTEGER), #{form.hasElevator}, #{form.daytimePhone}, #{form.fax}, 'active', NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING member_id

SELECT member_address_id, member_id, last_name, first_name, last_name_kana, first_name_kana, company_name, department_name, postal_code, prefecture, city, address_line, delivery_floor, has_elevator, daytime_phone, fax, created_at FROM member_additional_addresses WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT member_address_id, member_id, last_name, first_name, last_name_kana, first_name_kana, company_name, department_name, postal_code, prefecture, city, address_line, delivery_floor, has_elevator, daytime_phone, fax, created_at FROM member_additional_addresses WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_address_id = #{memberAddressId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_additional_addresses ( member_id, last_name, first_name, last_name_kana, first_name_kana, company_name, department_name, postal_code, prefecture, city, address_line, delivery_floor, has_elevator, daytime_phone, fax, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{form.lastName}, #{form.firstName}, #{form.lastNameKana}, #{form.firstNameKana}, #{form.companyName}, #{form.departmentName}, #{form.postalCode}, #{form.prefecture}, #{form.city}, #{form.addressLine}, CAST(#{form.deliveryFloor} AS INTEGER), #{form.hasElevator}, #{form.daytimePhone}, #{form.fax}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE member_additional_addresses SET last_name = #{form.lastName}, first_name = #{form.firstName}, last_name_kana = #{form.lastNameKana}, first_name_kana = #{form.firstNameKana}, company_name = #{form.companyName}, department_name = #{form.departmentName}, postal_code = #{form.postalCode}, prefecture = #{form.prefecture}, city = #{form.city}, address_line = #{form.addressLine}, delivery_floor = CAST(#{form.deliveryFloor} AS INTEGER), has_elevator = #{form.hasElevator}, daytime_phone = #{form.daytimePhone}, fax = #{form.fax}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_address_id = #{memberAddressId}
mapper.select: SELECT mf.product_id, p.product_name, MIN(pv.unit_price) AS min_price, MAX(pv.stock_quantity) AS max_stock, MIN(pv.product_code) AS product_code, mf.created_at FROM member_favorites mf JOIN products p ON p.product_id = mf.product_id JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_id = p.product_id WHERE mf.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.sale_start_at <= #{now} AND (p.sale_end_at IS NULL OR p.sale_end_at > #{now}) GROUP BY mf.product_id, p.product_name, mf.created_at ORDER BY mf.created_at DESC, mf.product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_favorites ( member_id, product_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET personal_or_corporate = #{form.personalOrCorporate}, last_name = #{form.lastName}, first_name = #{form.firstName}, last_name_kana = #{form.lastNameKana}, first_name_kana = #{form.firstNameKana}, company_name = #{form.companyName}, department_name = #{form.departmentName}, email = #{form.email}, gender = #{form.gender}, anniversary_date = #{form.anniversaryDate}, newsletter_opt_in = #{form.newsletterOptIn}, postal_code = #{form.postalCode}, prefecture = #{form.prefecture}, city = #{form.city}, address_line = #{form.addressLine}, delivery_floor = CAST(#{form.deliveryFloor} AS INTEGER), has_elevator = #{form.hasElevator}, daytime_phone = #{form.daytimePhone}, fax = #{form.fax}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_status = 'active'
UPDATE members SET member_status = 'withdrawn', withdrawn_at = #{now}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_status = 'active'
